'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Matt Sherrington DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Sherrington]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

No deck name. Username blank. Handwritten. DARK checked. Name line reads malix solosar. Line 1 written Imperial Occupation /... (V) → Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V). Line 5 Main Power Generators box empty → Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker). Line 20 written Blizzard - Rangefinder → Electro-Rangefinder. Line 22 written Veers (V). Line 26 The Emperor's Reach → Maarek Stele, The Emperor's Reach. Line 29 written General Novar → General Nevar. Lines 32–33 Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer. Line 35 SFS 9.3 Laser Cannons → SFS L-s9.3 Laser Cannons. Lines 38–39 both We're In Attack Position Now (printed numbers overwritten). Lines 41–42 written Masterful Move combo → Masterful Move & Endor Occupation; line 43 is Endor Occupation on its own. Line 47 written Imbalance combo → Imbalance & Kintan Strider. Line 51 short shield-word (V) → Endor Shield (V). Line 54 Prepare For A Surface Attack marked NO V; the box is scribbled, not (V). Line 59 Marquand In Blizzard 6 (not Colonel Marquand). Shield 6 Fanfare (V); shield 7 Firepower (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
